translations.web: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
translations.bsb: The sky receded like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.
translations.kjv: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
translations.asv: And the heaven was removed as a scroll when it is rolled up; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
